g.text: SYMMETRICAL DUAL-FACE "日" LADDER FRAME MODULAR SPEAKER ENCLOSURE
SYMMETRICAL FRONT & REAR "日" FRAMES (112x206x12mm) • 40mm CROSSBARS • TIE-BEAM BRACE (D=134mm) • WORKING DRAWINGS
NET VOLUME: 3.02 - 3.15 L NET (3.41L GROSS, 3.4L EFF)
SYMMETRY: Front: Z=0..28mm • Cavity: Z=28..162mm • Rear: Z=162..190mm
REAR PLATES: Solid Blanks (112x136 & 112x70, NO HOLES)
• 100% Symmetrical Chassis: Front and Rear feature identical
directly ties the front 40mm crossbar to the rear 40mm crossbar.
• Universal Modular Reversibility: Rear face comes equipped with
solid blanks (NO HOLES), but accepts ANY sub-baffle module.
• Future Testing Flexibility: Easily test rear passive radiators,
rear flared ports, or isobaric/bipolar dual-driver configurations.
2. 12mm UPPER DRIVER PLATES & REAR SOLID UPPER (112.0 x 136.0 x 12.0 mm)
PLS / W2 / ND65 (Cutout Ø56, Reb Ø68)
3. 12mm LOWER ACOUSTIC MODULES & REAR SOLID LOWER (112.0 x 70.0 x 12.0 mm)
4. CABINET PANELS CNC CUTLIST (12.0mm BIRCH PLYWOOD / MDF)
5. SYMMETRICAL DUAL-FACE SYSTEM MATRIX & BOM SCHEDULE
A. UPPER / LOWER COMBINATION ACOUSTIC MATRIX
Zero port chuffing, linear laminar airflow
Rear PR alignment, zero pipe resonance
B. SYMMETRICAL DUAL-FACE SYSTEM BOM SCHEDULE
Side walls with 134mm brace dado at Y=82mm
Front swappable Sealed, Port, Slit, PR
